name: What are the benefits of a walk-in shower compared to a traditional shower/tub combo?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of a walk-in shower compared to a traditional shower/tub combo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Walk-in showers offer several advantages over traditional shower/tub combinations. They provide enhanced accessibility, especially for individuals with mobility issues, as they eliminate a high threshold. Their open design creates a more spacious and modern aesthetic, potentially increasing home value. Maintenance can also be simpler due to fewer nooks and crannies, and customizability allows for personalized features like benches or unique tile patterns not easily incorporated into standard tubs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Walk-in showers offer better accessibility, a more spacious feel, modern aesthetics, and easier maintenance compared to traditional shower/tub combos.
